items.evidence: Reservoir slot 1 and plate slot 2 loaded with the required labels; p20 left and p300 right with matching tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
Log shows 12 pairs of aspirate 100 uL from reservoir A1 and dispense 100 uL into plate A1 through A12 using the P300; no other wells touched.
Log shows the P300 picking up a tip first and every aspirate/dispense after it, then dropping the tip at the end (step 26).
100 uL is within the P300 range, apiLevel 2.15 is valid, and the simulation passed. The blow_out after each dispense is harmless; it does not appear as a separate action in the log.
The protocol does only the requested transfer; metadata and comments are accurate and no extra steps change the outcome.

judge.summary: The protocol transfers 100 uL from reservoir A1 to plate wells A1-A12 with the P300 and one tip, matching the log exactly. All rubric items pass.
